result:
This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent the case, so I built nothing. I didn't commit a revision or submit a solve job, and I did not substitute other units.

The `list_models` catalogue has no isentropic pressure changer and no multi-outlet splitter:

- **`cmp1` (isentropic compressor) and `gts1`, `gts2`, `gts3` (isentropic turbine stages):** The only pressure-changing model is `syn001.valve`, which takes an outlet pressure and has no isentropic efficiency or work output. A valve is not a compressor or a turbine. The case's gas-turbine power specification (-477 MW) also depends on compressor and turbine work, and the catalogue has no model that produces it.
- **`splt1` (four-outlet splitter):** It splits compressed air into `air04`, `air05`, `air07` and `air09`. The catalogue's only splitters (`c1.stream_splitter` and `syn001.stream_splitter`) have exactly two outlets, `recycle` and `purge`.

Using `vsv`, `valve01`, `valve02` and `valve03` as valves would not have been a problem, and neither would the mixers, the heat exchanger or the feeds. The heat exchanger is `syn001.heat_exchanger`, and I did not check it against the case's LMTD heat-exchanger settings. I could not check the property side. No revision exists yet, and the model listing shows no property-method choice, so I can't say whether the Peng-Robinson route is available. I have not listed it as a limitation.
